facts.claim: Enchantment of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 1997; 81,500 GT; 2250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Vision class.
Enchantment of the Seas is the best way to take a few days to relax or play and hit some islands along the way. Book your next cruise on Enchantment of the Seas with Royal Caribbean Cruises.
Enchantment of the Seas is a Vision-class cruise ship operated by Royal Caribbean International.

catalogSpecs.description: Vision-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 1997; 81,500 GT; approx. 2,250 guests at double occupancy.
